reasons._note: Why the config is the way it is. Counts only; the gate reads none of this. Every exemption below is a choice written down, not a loosening: remove it and the gate counts more.
reasons.carlos-letter: data-name-exempt on p.qit: The Italian of Carlo's own writing and its English: the names in a quotation are the author's, not this archive's claims. Marked on the page itself (15 elements), counted in EX, ratcheted.
reasons.corrections: data-name-exempt on the 'wa: /corrections/ restates the superseded wording on purpose, verbatim, under the correction. Marked in corrections.astro (the span around the old sentence), counted in EX, ratcheted. The links in it stay.
reasons.citations without the generic 'page N' a: 173 of the 593 passages those two patterns find are bibliographic page numbers (pp. 7-490 of a printed book, cited in the Sources block) or a bare page number inside a register the sentence already named; neither is a record to link. Every other pattern is kept (DAPA image id, FamilySearch ark, waypoint and frame, Antenati ark, film, frame, folio). Add the two back when a records table covers register pages.
reasons.tables: skip: The tables on these pages are inventories and frame maps (which image is on which frame of a film, one image id per cell), not sentences that rely on a record. The prose around them is read. 123 cells would otherwise count (88 L3, 11 L4); none of them has a public address, and a frame map does not want a scan beside every row. David's decision to flip (kit option tables: records).
reasons.scans.link_only antenati, ark, waypoint-: FamilySearch frames and Antenati scans are link-only (David, 18 October 2026): a passage that cites one is asked for a link and never for a picture beside it. Only the family's own DAPA copy plates are asked for (L4).
reasons.record_links.prefixes: /sources/, /searched/, /antenati/ and /parish-books/ are lists of records the archive holds or has searched; /gallery/ and /register/ are not (a plate room, a list of leads) and are not accepted as a record link.
reasons.not in include: /cheryl-lerena/: A memoir with poems and writings by a member of the family: creative writing, so the names in it are not claims about records and no sentence cites one (0 citing passages). The page still gets the build-time name links; the standard simply does not count its names.
